data.name: Salaidh
data.long_meaning:
Derived from the Greek word ‘salax’, meaning tranquil or calm.
In ancient Greece, Salaidh was believed to be a goddess of peace and serenity.
In Christian tradition, Salaidh represents the inner calm and peace found through faith.
